newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices down after German, U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices down after German, U.S. data.

text.p: The Danish benchmark bond price recovered slightly but ended still down from Wednesday's close after Thursday's German tax news and U.S. CPI data, regarded by markets as disappointing.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down 0.27 point to 111.35, yielding 6.28 percent, off an earlier low of 111.26. The forthcoming benchmark seven percent state bond due 2007 was down 0.33 to 103.92, yielding 6.46 percent.
The yield gap between the 2006 bond and the German bund was unchanged from its earlier 56 basis points and the 2007-bund gap was likewise static at 74 bp.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 fell 0.25 point, to 89.75.
The crown weakened to 3.8090 per mark, from Wednesday's 3.8067. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
